description: For finite Harrop \(\Gamma\), \(h:X\to Y\in\Gamma\), actual \(u:\Gamma\Rightarrow X\), and actual continuation \(q:\Gamma,Y\Rightarrow A\lor B\), extraction from implication-left with \(h,u,q\) is exactly the implication-left lift with the same \(h,u\) of extraction from that same \(q\).
